task_name: Meridian Motors - Showroom vehicle image system
client_brief:
Standardise a used-car photo set without changing the cars

We photograph stock in three different bays at Meridian Motors. That is showing up in our listings: the same forecourt can look like three dealerships, and paint colours move around with the light.

The commission

 Vehicle sales card: 6 named exports. The vehicle photograph matches this stock record. The vehicle condition is not misrepresented by retouching. The enquiry action is readable.

 Forecourt inventory campaign: 1 named export. The dealership name is clear. The campaign uses vehicles present in the intake register.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: Certified pre-owned car dealership taking roughly six vehicles a week onto the lot.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: An independent certified pre-owned dealership in Portland, Maine, photographing every car in house across three lot bays.
brand_identity.about: Meridian Motors sells certified pre-owned vehicles between 22,000 and 38,000 dollars to families replacing an ageing car. The listings are the whole business, and the visual argument is simple: this is an orderly operation with nothing to hide. Every car should look as if it were photographed in one clean, evenly lit showroom, with honest paint and legible plain information.
brand_identity.audience: Buyers aged 30 to 55 replacing a ten year old family car, deciding on trust before they decide on the vehicle.
brand_identity.price_positioning: 22,000 to 38,000 dollars certified pre-owned. The treatment is an even, neutral, well lit showroom white with the full vehicle in frame and honest colour. Never a dark dramatic studio look, which reads as evasive at this price, and never hot saturated pictures with starbursts and a price slash, which read as a buy here pay here lot.
brand_identity.typography: A clear humanist sans doing most of the work, sized so a price and a mileage read at a glance, with a slightly firmer cut for the roundel wordmark. Organised and plainly legible, neither luxury nor discount.
brand_identity.voice: Straightforward and unadorned, the voice of a desk that states the facts. Example line the brand would write: "2017 Calder Kestrel, 68,400 miles. Certified. 24,900 dollars."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The only mark on file is the compass roundel as the sign shop supplied it years ago, a small flat raster on a white square at signage thumbnail size, which has never mattered until now. The window cards survive only as the retired printer's press PDF, and the room now hand writes them. The roundel belongs on the firm's own collateral and never on a marketplace primary.
brand_identity.values: Order and honesty above effect: the listing is the vehicle a buyer will walk around in person, so it must show the real car, plainly.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

assets.description: Transparent, tightly bounded Adobe-vectorized roundel master cleaned from the supplied artwork.
1600 px transparent raster companion for placement and preview.
White vector variant for approved dark-ground use.
